event_name: Dodge NHRA Great Lakes Nationals presented by MOPAR

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 61 degrees, relative humidity 71 percent, barometer 30.16 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,137 feet. 

12 of the 14 Pro Stock wins this year have come from the top half of the field.

Dallas Glenn's win in Valdosta (#9) and Aaron Stanfield's win in Norwalk (#10) are the only Pro Stock
wins this year from the bottom half of the 
field.

Matt Latino's 12-2 Round 1 record is tied for the best in Pro Stock this year.

Troy Coughlin Jr. is 5-9 in Round 1 this year.

Coughlin Jr. with a great light and the power to hold on for the hole shot win.  He makes his
quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Latino is a tick too quick on the tree and turns on the red light.

Latino makes his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Jeg Coughlin has gone 33 races without a win. He is 10-2 against Erica Enders in Round 1 races.

Erica Enders has gone 19 races without a win. 2019 was the last time she entered the Countdown
without a win.

Coughlin is 22 - 13 against Enders in prior events. 

Enders goes red to give Coughlin the win.

Coughlin with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Greg Stanfield wins 68% of his Round 1 races when he has lane choice.

Eric Latino is 2-4 in Round 1 when qualified #10.

Stanfield is 2 - 1 against Latino in prior events. 

Stanfield with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest pass
of the weekend for the win.


Latino with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Cody Anderson is 6-8 in Round 1 this year.

Kenny Delco beat Anderson in Round 1 in Valdosta.

Anderson with the starting line advantage for the win.  He makes his quickest pass of the weekend for
the win. He will give up lane choice in the next round to Greg Stanfield.

Delco with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Matt Hartford wins 72% of his Round 1 races when he has lane choice (100% when qualified #1).

Shane Tucker lost to Hartford in Round 1 in Bristol.

Hartford is 2 - 1 against Tucker in prior events. 

Tucker with a great light, but Hartford chased him down for the win.  He matches his qualifying time
for the win.  He will have a bye in the next round

Dallas Glenn has lost in Round 1 at two of the last four races. Those are his only Round 1 losses
this year.

Deric Kramer is 0-4 against Glenn in Round 1.

Glenn is 9 - 0 against Kramer in prior events. 

Glenn with the starting line advantage but has severe tire shake and pushes the clutch back in.

Kramer is straight down the groove with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.  He will give
up lane choice to Jeg Coughlin in the next round.

Greg Anderson has been in either first or second place after 30 of the last 31 races.

In his 26 meetings with Greg Anderson, Aaron Stanfield has "left first" 17 times.

Stanfield is 17 - 9 against Anderson in prior events. 

Anderson with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest pass
of the weekend, but will give up lane choice to Troy Coughlin Jr. in the next round.

Stanfield with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.
